{{Quote|Vryim? He's dead? No. Oh, but I think I knew. I think I felt something when he died. Something that drew me out of the city to this place. I just didn't understand until now. Oh, Vryim. I'll miss you.|[[Cara Raeth]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FCRhV" />}}
'''Vryim Raeth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|He's in there. My husband, Vryim. They took him. They said he knew things about their organization that he shouldn't know. But he didn't. He's just a vehicle repairman. They said they were going to use him in their experiments. What does that mean? Oh, Vryim, I miss you. I want you back.|Cara Raeth, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FCRhV" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vryim Raeth was a vehicle repairman on Corellia where he lived with his wife, [[Cara Raeth]].<ref name="SWG:FCRhV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Vryim Raeth was kidnapped by the criminal organization known as [[Chirq Council]] and taken to the [[First Elite Council Bunker]], near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. The criminals suspected he knew too much information about their organization, and decided to use him in their experiments. He was later assassinated by the criminals. His wife, Cara was able to track her missing husband to the First Elite Council Bunker. While there she asked a spacer to enter the bunker and rescue her husband. The spacer discovered Vryim's corpse inside and reported the news of his demise back to Cara, who was devastated at the loss of her husband. <ref name="SWG:FCRhV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vryim Raeth appeared as a corpse in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FCRhV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vryim Raeth was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
